project.name: SciPal
project.description: Local-first retrieval-augmented research workbench for literature search, structured evidence, systematic review and traceable writing.

warning: Do not use for clinical or regulated decisions.
APIs and schemas may change without notice.
Cold endpoints are smoke-tested, not fully regression-tested.

runtime.async: threaded workers plus PostgreSQL task records

tech_stack.full_text: PostgreSQL GIN tsvector; optional ParadeDB path
tech_stack.parsing: PyMuPDF, Docling, GROBID, MinerU, JATS XML
tech_stack.generation: OpenAI-compatible cloud API, Ollama local fallback, DSH optional
tech_stack.deployment: Docker Compose: app + watch-cron + Caddy + PostgreSQL

principle: Every evidence item traces to paper, section, paragraph, sentence, page and bbox.
Claims must bind to explicit quotes.
State changes are append-only audit events.
External capabilities are pluggable and removable; SciPal core stays stable.
startup: create Flask app and register 26 blueprints
warm embedding/reranker models on first use

deployment.notes: research.db and Chroma are not mounted in production

limitations: 12 title-duplicate groups with different PMCIDs are not merged.
GraphRAG / RAPTOR are plugin experiments, not main architecture.
Client ingest tracking plugin is not wired to real import UI.
Base image still contains chromadb package although runtime does not use it.
Some cold POST endpoints are not covered by automated smoke tests.

docs.smoke_plan: docs/全站端点分层烟测计划.md

collaboration.rule: one topic per branch/PR; human approval before merge
collaboration.review: PR body includes scope, changes, metrics, risks

plugins.raptor: summaries table available; retrieval experiment pending

benchmark_db.sqlite: small single-process checks only with explicit opt-in
